records.title: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Postdoctoral Fellowships
records.awarding_body: European Commission (Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions)
records.deadline_label: The completed proposal, including all annexes, can be submitted at any time from the opening date of the chosen call and should be submitted by the specified submission deadline of the chosen call.
records.eligibility_summary: Excellent researchers of any nationality holding a PhD; mobility rule (must not have resided/worked in recruiting country >12 months in past 36 months); open to those reintegrating to Europe or displaced by conflict.

records.title: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
records.awarding_body: DAAD — German Academic Exchange Service (funded by BMZ)
records.deadline_label: Varies by course (typically August-November annually for next intake)
records.eligibility_summary: Graduates from developing and newly industrialised countries on the DAAD DAC list; at least two years of professional experience; above-average academic results; development-related motivation; must not have resided in Germany >15 months before application.

records.title: Netherlands Fellowship Programme (NFP/OTS)
records.awarding_body: Nuffic (Study in NL)
records.deadline_label: Varies by programme — check Nuffic website
records.eligibility_summary: Employed in eligible developing country, employer nomination required, under 45

records.title: Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship
records.awarding_body: The University of Edinburgh
records.eligibility_summary: Open to students liable to pay overseas tuition fees who have been offered admission to a full-time PhD research programme at the University of Edinburgh and who are of outstanding academic merit and research potential, in any subject offered by the University. Financial means, nationality and the proposed field of study are not taken into account.

records.title: International Industrial Talents Education Special Program (INTENSE Program)
records.awarding_body: Ministry of Education (MOE), Republic of China (Taiwan), with the National Development Council, participating universities and partner companies
records.deadline_label: There is no single INTENSE deadline. Each participating university sets its own application window and nomination deadline per intake, and the two intakes do not coincide. Windows published by partner universities for 2027 Spring include 10 September to 12 October 2026 (NCHU), 1 to 22 October 2026 (NCU) and 21 September to 23 October 2026 (KMU), all GMT+8; for 2027 Fall, NTUT publishes a student nomination deadline of 10 March 2027. Applications for several 2027 Spring intakes are open as of 2026-10-04.
records.eligibility_summary: International students who meet the MOE Regulations Regarding International Students Undertaking Studies in Taiwan and who are recruited by a participating university for an approved INTENSE programme in a key industry field. Nationality targets differ by programme and university, with Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines and Thailand commonly named, and some programmes open to students of all nationalities. English-taught programmes require CEFR B1 English at admission; Chinese-taught programmes require TOCFL Level B1.

records.title: Budapest University of Technology and Economics (BME) Scholarships
records.awarding_body: Budapest University of Technology and Economics
records.degree_levels: Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral (outbound mobility for BME students)
records.deadline_label: 15 January 2026, 2:00 p.m. CET
records.eligibility_summary: No eligibility criteria could be read for an inbound BME scholarship, because no such programme page exists on bme.hu. The outbound mobility page is aimed at current BME students, and the current-scholarships index is aimed at students already enrolled at BME, many of whom must be Hungarian citizens.

records.title: VU Fellowship Programme (VUFP)
records.awarding_body: VU Amsterdam
records.funding_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver + living cost contribution
records.deadline_label: Applications are welcome from November 1st 2026. Deadline VUFP application: 1 February 2027 (23:59 CET)
records.eligibility_summary: Talented non-EEA/EEA students applying for a Master's programme at VU Amsterdam. Must be conditionally admitted before applying. Automatically applies for NL Scholarship when applying for VUFP.

records.title: KTH Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Kth.Se
records.deadline_label: 1 December 2026: Application opens. 15 January 2027: Application closes. 1 April 2027: Scholarship results announced
records.eligibility_summary: Fee-paying international students (non-EU/EEA/Swiss) who have applied for a master's programme at KTH as their first priority via universityadmissions.se and paid the application fee. Must demonstrate academic excellence and drive to contribute to sustainable development.

records.title: KTH India Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Kth.Se
records.funding_type: Full tuition waiver + monthly living allowance
records.deadline_label: 15 January 2027
records.eligibility_summary: Indian applicants admitted to a master's programme at KTH. Applicants from Mumbai and Pune receive priority under the foundation rules, but the scholarship remains open to eligible Indian applicants from other regions. Very competitive (one award offered in 2026).

records.title: Benjamin A. Gilman International Scholarship Program
records.awarding_body: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (administered by the Institute of International Education)
records.deadline_label: Fall 2026 application cycle: deadline October 1, 2026 at 11:59PM PT, now closed. Next cycle, Spring 2027: student deadline February 25, 2027 at 11:59pm Pacific Time, with the advisor certification deadline March 4, 2027 and the application cycle opening mid-January 2027.
records.eligibility_summary: American undergraduate students with high financial need who are receiving, or can prove they will receive, a Federal Pell Grant, and who are enrolled in an eligible credit-bearing study abroad or international internship programme.

records.title: SA-TIED Request for Research Proposals: Public revenue mobilization; Poverty, inequality, and labour markets
records.awarding_body: United Nations University World Institute for Development Economics Research (UNU-WIDER), with the National Treasury of South Africa
records.deadline_label: Closing date: 15 October 2026, 23:59 (UTC+2). Submit questions by 8 October 2026.
records.eligibility_summary: Proposals are welcome from individuals, groups of individuals and non-profit organisations, using South Africa-based and international researchers, with South African researchers, women, and early-career and Global South scholars particularly encouraged.

records.title: Albert Einstein Distinguished Educator Fellowship (AEF) Program
records.awarding_body: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science, Office of Workforce Development for Teachers and Scientists (WDTS), administered with the Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education (ORISE)
records.degree_levels: Not a degree programme - professional fellowship for K-12 STEM educators
records.deadline_label: Application deadline 8:00pm Eastern, November 5, 2026. Online application opened August 3, 2026. The application period typically opens in mid-August, with applications due in mid-November.
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be U.S. citizens who have completed five years of full-time STEM classroom teaching, have taught full-time in a U.S. public or private elementary or secondary school or school district for at least five of the last seven years, are currently so employed, can obtain an eleven-month leave of absence, and can obtain a recommendation letter from a school district official.

records.title: Office of Science Graduate Student Research (SCGSR) Program
records.awarding_body: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science, Office of Workforce Development for Teachers and Scientists (WDTS), administered with Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education (ORISE)
records.deadline_label: Applications are due November 4, 2026, at 5:00PM ET. This is 2026 Solicitation 2. The online application system closes at 5:00 PM Eastern Time and no additional materials will be accepted after it. 2027 Solicitation 1 dates are published but all tentative: application opens February 2027, applications due May 2027.
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents aged 18 or older, full-time enrolled in a qualified thesis-based Ph.D. programme in a DOE-supported STEM field, have obtained Ph.D. candidacy with an approved thesis topic, and secure a collaborating scientist at a participating DOE national laboratory.

records.title: Chevening Europe Defence and Security Fellowship
records.awarding_body: Chevening (UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office scheme), delivered by Cranfield University
records.deadline_label: Open for applications until 12 October 2026, at 11:00 (UTC)
records.eligibility_summary: Must meet the general Chevening Fellowship eligibility criteria plus the programme-specific rules: citizenship and residence in one of 35 listed European countries, a postgraduate qualification, at least five years' relevant professional experience, and a security-related role with influence potential.

records.title: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation PhD Scholarship (2027 competition)
records.awarding_body: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation
records.deadline_label: November 6, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET (deadline to submit the complete application); October 2, 2026 (deadline to request eligibility confirmation); October 30, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET (deadline for receipt of all three references)
records.eligibility_summary: Doctoral students in the first or second year of a PhD at the time of application whose research is broadly humanities/social sciences and aligns with at least one of the Foundation's four themes, who are either a Canadian student enrolled at a Canadian university, a Canadian student enrolled at a university outside Canada, or an international student enrolled at a Canadian university.

records.title: Alberta Innovates Graduate Student Scholarships
records.awarding_body: Alberta Innovates (Government of Alberta provincial agency), delivered through participating Alberta post-secondary institutions
records.deadline_label: No single calendar deadline is published. The Alberta Innovates programme page gives the due date as "Continuous" and states "This program is accepting applications on a seasonal basis. Intake Open Date is specific to each individual university; please contact your university of choice for deadline information." At the University of Calgary, "The Graduate Award Competition opens November 1 of each year" and "Deadlines vary by program"; the Faculty of Graduate Studies reference deadline is February 1.
records.eligibility_summary: Canadian, permanent resident or international graduate students conducting full-time research in information and communications technologies or advanced materials and manufacturing technologies at one of the five named participating Alberta post-secondary institutions, whose project develops rather than merely uses an emerging technology and who can articulate its potential impact for Alberta.

records.title: Hanns-Seidel-Stiftung Scholarship – Förderung internationaler Studierender und Promovierender (Scholarship for Studies / PhDs for international students and doctoral candidates)
records.awarding_body: Hanns-Seidel-Stiftung e. V., Institut für Begabtenförderung
records.deadline_label: Application portal open 15 December 2026 to 15 January 2027 inclusive (12:00 CET) for Internationale Studierende und Promovierende (Ausländer); a further window 15 June 2027 to 15 July 2027 (12:00 CEST). Applications possible only via the HSS online application portal.
records.eligibility_summary: Under 45, proven German skills of at least B2 or comparable, above-average performance, voluntary engagement, political interest, civic-mindedness, acceptance of the foundation's aims, and a full-time course of study at a state or state-recognised higher education institution in Germany.

records.title: Flanders Trainee Programme (Flanders Traineeship Programme)
records.awarding_body: Government of Flanders — Flanders Trainee Programme (Departement Buitenlandse Zaken)
records.deadline_label: Closing date for applications: 1st March
records.eligibility_summary: You must be under 35 when the internship starts, hold a secondary or higher education diploma obtained in Flanders, and have secured an internship of at least two months with an organisation on the published list of qualifying multilateral organisations.

records.title: Nordic Scholarship Programme (Nordic Africa Institute)
records.awarding_body: The Nordic Africa Institute (NAI), Uppsala
records.deadline_label: Closing date 11 October 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Africa-oriented studies or research in the social sciences or humanities, with a current affiliation to a university or research centre in Sweden, Finland, Denmark or Iceland, held both at the time of application and when the scholarship is taken up.

records.title: ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award
records.awarding_body: The Australian National University
records.deadline_label: Application period: Open for applications. ANU publishes no closing date for this award; consideration is automatic with the admissions application.
records.eligibility_summary: The award is available to an international student who is a new commencing student, or a continuing student with an offer of admission to a higher AQF level, who holds residential status in China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, the Republic of Korea or the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, meets the minimum academic entry requirements (Selection Rank of 85 or equivalent for undergraduate, minimum GPA of 5.5 or equivalent for postgraduate), is not the recipient of an external sponsorship covering all or part of their tuition fees at ANU, and accepts that the award can be offered only once at each level of study.

records.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for 2027 - Research Students (Embassy Recommendation)
records.awarding_body: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan - administered in-country through Japanese embassies/consulates
records.funding_type: Research Students stipend, 2027 English guidelines: preparatory education and non-regular students 143,000 yen per month; regular students enrolled in master's or professional degree courses 144,000 yen per month; regular students enrolled in doctoral courses 145,000 yen per month; plus a supplemental regional allowance of 2,000 yen or 3,000 yen per month.
records.deadline_label: No central deadline is published. MEXT states that all procedures for the Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarships are conducted through Japanese embassies, consulates in your countries, or institutions of higher education in Japan; candidates should contact the Japanese embassy (or consulate general) in their own country for the application date, and the Study in Japan page states that the type and field of application may vary from country to country and that applicants should check with the Japanese embassy or other Japanese diplomatic mission for any openings.
records.eligibility_summary: Research students must be under 35 years of age and be eligible for admission to a master's programme or a doctoral programme (first or second stage) at a Japanese graduate school.

records.title: Young Leaders' Program (YLP) - Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship, GRIPS School of Government and School of Local Governance
records.awarding_body: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan - hosted at the National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS)
records.deadline_label: No central deadline is published. MEXT states that all application procedures for Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarships are conducted through Japanese embassies, consulates in your countries, or institutions of higher education in Japan, and candidates should ask their own embassy/consulate. GRIPS publishes the application window as a historical reference only: application acceptance period (last year's result) July to October, with results announced the following April.
records.eligibility_summary: YLP students must be under 40 years of age (in principle), and be university or college graduates who have practical work experience, young public administrators and others who are expected to play an active role in Asia and other countries.

records.title: GKS (Global Korea Scholarship) Program - Undergraduate Degree Programs
records.awarding_body: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea
records.deadline_label: Embassy Track: September / University Track: September - November (2026 intake; monthly precision - the page states the month, not a day)
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants and both of their parents must hold non-Korean citizenship, be under 25 as of the applicable year, hold the published minimum educational qualification for the track, and meet the published academic-performance requirement.

records.title: Japan Africa Dream Scholarship (JADS) Program
records.awarding_body: African Development Bank Group, with the Government of Japan
records.deadline_label: The African Development Bank publishes no central JADS call opening or closing date, so there is no central deadline to quote. Applications go only through the partner universities, and the AfDB's own "List of Universities" page publishes each partner's intake and application window: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University - "Application Deadlines are as following: April Enrollment: October / September Enrollment: April"; Hiroshima University Graduate School of Advanced Science and Engineering - "Month of Intake: April - Preliminary Survey: Oct 18-29 - Application period: Nov 8-19 - Exam. Period: Nov 29-Dec 8" and, for its second course, "Preliminary Evaluation for Apr. Oct 4-8, Preliminary Evaluation for Oct.: Mar. 7-11, Application Period for Apr.: Nov 4-15, Application Period for Oct.: Apr. 4-22"; The University of Tokyo Graduate School of Frontier Sciences - "Month of Intake: April or October / Examination: Schedule A (application period: mid June) Schedule B (application period: mid November)"; Sophia University - "Month of Intake: September / Deadline of Application: Web entry: Mid of March ~ Early April; Application: Mid of April". Kyoto University and Kogakuin University are listed with "Please refer to the program website".
records.eligibility_summary: Must be 35 or younger, in good health, a citizen of an African Development Bank regional member country, hold a relevant bachelor's degree with an excellent academic record plus at least one year of paid employment earned within the past three years, and secure admission to an approved master's course at a JADS partner university.

records.title: Mandela Washington Fellowship for Young African Leaders (2027 Fellowship)
records.awarding_body: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs, with funding provided by the U.S. Government; administered by IREX
records.degree_levels: Non-degree (six-week executive-style exchange programme; no degree is awarded)
records.deadline_label: "APPLICATION DEADLINE: 16:00/4:00 PM GMT on Tuesday, October 13, 2026" and "The deadline for applications for the Mandela Washington Fellowship is 16:00/4:00 PM GMT on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. Applications must be submitted using the online application system at apply.mandelawashingtonfellowship.org." "There is no fee to apply for the Mandela Washington Fellowship."
records.eligibility_summary: Must be aged 25-35 on 13 October 2026 (exceptional 21-24 applicants may be considered), a citizen and permanent resident of one of 49 listed Sub-Saharan African countries, proficient in English, J-1 visa eligible, not a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, not a U.S. Government employee or immediate family member, and not a previous Mandela Washington Fellow or participant.

records.title: UNHCR Tertiary Refugee Scholarship Programme (DAFI) - Albert Einstein German Academic Refugee Initiative
records.awarding_body: UNHCR (funded by the Government of Germany, with support from the Governments of Denmark and the Czech Republic and private donors; implemented by UNHCR country operations and DAFI partners such as Windle International)
records.deadline_label: No single global deadline is published. Deadlines are set per country operation and published on the UNHCR country help pages (published 2026/2027 examples: Rwanda 7 August 2026; Kyrgyzstan 21 August 2026; Slovakia 31 August 2026). Applicants must check their own country operation's call.
records.eligibility_summary: Recognised refugees and, in selected countries, returnees seeking an undergraduate (ISCED 6) or short-cycle tertiary/TVET (ISCED 5, two years or more) place in their country of asylum or home country, who are not in receipt of another higher-education scholarship.

records.title: University of Glasgow Sanctuary Scholarship
records.awarding_body: University of Glasgow
records.deadline_label: Applications for this scholarship for the 2027-28 academic session will open soon. In the meantime please provide your details and we will be in touch when the scholarship is open for applications.
records.eligibility_summary: UK-based applicants with refugee or asylum seeker status, or arrival through a named UK resettlement scheme, holding a firm offer for full-time study at the University of Glasgow and ineligible for mainstream student finance funding.

records.title: Ernst Mach Grant – worldwide
records.awarding_body: OeAD-GmbH – Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation
records.deadline_label: Closing date for applications: 01.12.2026. Online application is possible from September to December 1st; the application deadline for this grant is December 1st, 2026, 23:59 (CET) for all applications for stays during the academic year 2027/28.
records.eligibility_summary: Young researchers from countries other than Austria, aged 35 or under at the start of the stay, who are pursuing a PhD outside Austria or who completed their studies abroad after 30 September 2025, and who have a written supervision confirmation from an Austrian university lecturer.

records.title: RISE Germany - Research Internships in Science and Engineering
records.awarding_body: Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst (DAAD)
records.deadline_label: Applications: October 15 - November 30, 2026 (11:59 pm CET - Central European Time); Letters of reference: October 15 - December 15, 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate students in science, engineering and computer science at North American, British and Irish universities who have completed at least two years of study.

records.title: Scholarships for Refugees (Studien- und PromotionsfÃ¶rderung)
records.awarding_body: Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung
records.deadline_label: Apply online on campus.kas.de until 15 January or 15 July annually.
records.eligibility_summary: Students in Germany with a refugee-related residence permit, above-average academic achievements, identification with the values of the Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung, voluntary engagement and initiative.

records.title: Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
records.awarding_body: German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD)
records.deadline_label: Depending on chosen study programme; please check the DAAD list of application deadlines or the website of the chosen study programme. Applications are sent directly to the course, not to the DAAD.
records.eligibility_summary: Graduates with at least two years' professional experience from DAAD-listed developing and newly industrialised countries, who hold a relevant Bachelor degree with far above average results and whose degree is normally not more than six years old.

records.title: MOPGA 2027: Visiting Fellowship Program for Early Career Researchers
records.awarding_body: Campus France, funded by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE) in partnership with the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Space (MESRE)
records.deadline_label: Application deadline: 15 December 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Foreign researchers whose PhD was defended between December 2021 and December 2026 inclusive, applying from outside France for a research stay in France.

records.title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship for Research in Japan (Short-term Program for North American and European Researchers, PE)
records.awarding_body: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS), Overseas Fellowship Division, International Program Department
records.deadline_label: FY2027 2nd recruitment: January 8, 2027, 5 p.m. JST, submission from the Japanese host institution to JSPS. FY2027 3rd recruitment: June 4, 2027, 5 p.m. JST. The FY2027 1st recruitment closed on September 25, 2026.
records.eligibility_summary: Candidates resident in an eligible North American or European country who obtained a doctoral degree within the past six years as of April 1 of the fiscal year, or who are enrolled in a doctoral course and expect a PhD within two years of the fellowship start date.

records.title: Apoyo Complementario SECIHTI-OEA 2026
records.awarding_body: Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación (Secihti) and Organización de los Estados Americanos (OAS)
records.deadline_label: Fecha de cierre del proceso: 30 de noviembre de 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants must already be current Secihti National Scholarship holders admitted and enrolled in a full-time postgraduate programme in a listed subject area, and be nationals of an OAS Member State other than Mexico.

records.title: UNESCO/Japan Young Researchers' Fellowships Programme (UNESCO/Keizo Obuchi Research Fellowships Programme) - Cycle 2026
records.awarding_body: UNESCO, funded by the Government of Japan under the Japanese Funds-in-Trust for the Capacity-Building of Human Resources
records.deadline_label: Deadline for candidate submission is now extended to 15 October 2026, midnight Paris time. Letters of nomination and all application documents must reach UNESCO from the National Commissions no later than 15 October 2026, and candidates must submit to their own National Commission at least 2 weeks before the required deadline.
records.eligibility_summary: National of an invited Member State or Associate Member, aged no more than 40 at the time of application, holding at least a Master's degree or equivalent relevant to the proposed research, proficient in the language of instruction or supervision at the Japanese host institution, and already accepted by an academic supervisor at a Japanese university or research institution.

records.title: HFA Research and Training Grants Programme (Heart Failure Association of the European Society of Cardiology)
records.awarding_body: Heart Failure Association of the European Society of Cardiology (HFA-ESC)
records.deadline_label: 30 September (the call runs 10 April - 30 September each year)
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be under 40, be an HFA member or Fellow, hold an MD without a permanent, senior staff or consultant post with demonstrated heart failure expertise, or hold a PhD or have submitted a thesis, and must carry out their project in an ESC member country outside their own for at least three months.

records.title: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships
records.awarding_body: European Molecular Biology Organization (EMBO)
records.deadline_label: Friday 22 January 2027, 14:00 CET
records.eligibility_summary: PhD holders in the life sciences who obtained their doctorate within the two years before submitting the application, have at least one first-author publication (or verifiably peer-reviewed first-author preprint), and are applying to move to a different country than where the PhD was obtained.

records.title: Maria Leptin | EMBO Science Journalism Fellowships
records.awarding_body: European Molecular Biology Organization (EMBO)
records.deadline_label: 30 October each year, 23:59 Central European Summer Time (applications may be submitted at any time but must be registered by this deadline)
records.eligibility_summary: Either an employed or freelance working journalist with demonstrable relevant experience and samples of published or broadcast work who wants to deepen their science knowledge, or a life scientist with a master's degree or higher who wants to transition into full-time science journalism and has prior reporting on the life sciences.

records.title: International Excellence Entrance Scholarship
records.awarding_body: University of Manitoba
records.deadline_label: December 1 (2027/28 cycle)
records.eligibility_summary: International high school graduates applying to University 1 or any faculty, college or school at the University of Manitoba with a direct entry option, enrolled full-time in the first year of study (minimum 80% course load). The $25,000 first-place award requires a 90% minimum admission average across five senior level courses plus demonstrated leadership; the two $10,000 awards require the minimum admission requirements for the programme plus demonstrated leadership.

records.title: Killam Predoctoral Scholarship Level 2 (Doctoral)
records.awarding_body: Dalhousie University, Faculty of Graduate Studies
records.deadline_label: Round one: October 16, 2026 at midnight AT. Round two: opens December 1, 2026 - submissions due January 31, 2027 at midnight AT.
records.eligibility_summary: Full-time doctoral (PhD) students at Dalhousie University, Canadian or international. Applicants must demonstrate exceptional academic achievement, strong research potential and a clear likelihood of contributing to the advancement of learning in their field, with character, ethical conduct and contributions to a respectful and inclusive community also considered. The award must be taken up no later than the 7th term of the PhD, and applicants must have spent fewer than six terms (24 months) in the PhD as of May 1 of the award year.

records.title: Dalhousie Research Excellence Scholarship (DRES)
records.awarding_body: Dalhousie University, Faculty of Graduate Studies
records.deadline_label: Round one: October 16, 2026 at midnight AT. Round two: opens December 1, 2026 - submissions due January 31, 2027 at midnight AT.
records.eligibility_summary: New PhD students at Dalhousie intending to enrol in or transfer to a PhD programme between January 2027 and January 2028, from Canada or abroad. Applicants must demonstrate outstanding research achievement, exceptional leadership potential, and the capacity to generate significant regional, national or international impact through their research.

records.title: National Humanities Center Residential Fellowship
records.awarding_body: National Humanities Center
records.degree_levels: PhD (terminal degree required; postdoctoral researchers and doctoral candidates are not eligible)
records.deadline_label: Applications open July 1; deadline October 1; letters of recommendation due October 8
records.eligibility_summary: Holders of a PhD or equivalent terminal degree earned at least five years before applying, engaged in humanities research that will result in publication, with a substantial record of peer-reviewed scholarship beyond the dissertation. Faculty at research universities, liberal arts and teaching colleges, HBCUs, HSIs, tribal colleges and universities and international institutions, as well as independent scholars, may apply. Applicants of any citizenship are eligible and the Center sponsors J-1 Research Scholar visas.

records.title: Building Brighter Futures: Bursaries and Scholarships (Indspire)
records.awarding_body: Indspire
records.deadline_label: August 1, November 1, February 1 at 11:59 p.m. EST
records.eligibility_summary: First Nations, Inuit and Métis students in Canada seeking funding for full-time or part-time post-secondary study in college, university, skilled trades, apprenticeships and technology programmes, including certificate and diploma programmes of one month to four years. Applicants complete a single application that is considered for all Indspire bursaries and scholarships.

records.title: Perimeter Institute PhD Residency Program Award
records.awarding_body: Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics
records.funding_type: Doctoral funding package (university salary plus Perimeter top-up)
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants must apply to a PhD programme at one of Perimeter's listed partner universities (Dalhousie, McMaster, University of Guelph, University of Toronto, University of Waterloo, Western, York) with a Perimeter-affiliated supervisor, and must submit a separate Expression of Interest to the Residency Award.

records.title: OAS-AUWCL Scholarship Program (American University Washington College of Law LL.M.)
records.awarding_body: Organization of American States, General Secretariat (with American University Washington College of Law)
records.deadline_label: 1 November 2026 (residential/in-person LL.M., Spring 2027); 30 November 2026 (hybrid and online LL.M., Spring 2027)
records.eligibility_summary: Citizens and/or permanent legal residents of any active OAS member state except the United States, who hold a Juris Doctor from an ABA-accredited US law school or a first law degree from a foreign law school of equivalent standard, and who are admitted to one of the AUWCL LL.M. programmes. Open to new applicants and to current AUWCL students; not open to current OAS scholarship holders, GS/OAS staff, consultants, Permanent Officials or their immediate relatives.

records.title: Asian University for Women Scholarships and Financial Aid (full and partial need-based aid)
records.awarding_body: Asian University for Women (AUW), Chittagong
records.deadline_label: No closing date is published; applications run with the annual admissions cycle and the official pages state that admissions are open
records.eligibility_summary: Women who have completed 12 years of schooling (10+2) with at least 60% in their final Grade X and Grade XII examinations, including at least 60% in English and in Maths individually, and are within 22 years of age. The university is required under its Charter to recruit primarily from South, Southeast and West Asia and the Middle East, and also accepts stateless students and applicants from outside Asia. Financial aid is decided separately by the Financial Aid Committee on assessed family circumstances, not on admission merit.

records.title: John Allwright Fellowship
records.awarding_body: Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR)
records.deadline_label: 30 April 2026, 14:00 AEST
records.eligibility_summary: Scientists or economists from ACIAR partner countries who are currently or recently involved in ACIAR research projects, seeking postgraduate qualifications at an Australian tertiary institution.

records.title: International Academic Merit Scholarship (Griffith University)
records.awarding_body: Griffith University
records.funding_type: Tuition Fee Waiver (20% of tuition fees)
records.deadline_label: No closing date - the scholarship is assessed automatically when you apply to study at Griffith
records.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries other than Australia or New Zealand, full-time students starting in Trimester 3 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027, with a minimum GPA of 4.5 on a 7-point scale (or equivalent), meeting the academic and English language entry requirements of their chosen coursework program.

records.title: Massey University Doctoral Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Massey University
records.deadline_label: 1 October 2026
records.eligibility_summary: For candidates enrolled in, or holding an offer of place for, the Doctor of Philosophy, Doctor of Clinical Psychology or Doctor of Social Work at Massey University, at the closing date. Applicants need a GPA of 7.0 or higher, must be researching a topic of strategic value to the University, and must agree to the scholarship regulations.

records.title: Cusanuswerk Promotionsstipendium (Auswahlverfahren für Promovierende) — Cusanuswerk Doctoral Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Cusanuswerk – Bischöfliche Studienförderung
records.deadline_label: Sunday, 1 November 2026 (registration deadline for Verfahren I-2027, selection decision March 2027)
records.eligibility_summary: Outstanding academic performance, interdisciplinary interest, social responsibility and voluntary engagement, membership in the Catholic Church with a lived Christian faith, university entrance qualification, and admission to doctoral study at a recognised university.

records.title: ERS Visiting Mid-Career Investigator Travel (VISIT) Grant
records.awarding_body: European Respiratory Society (ERS)
records.deadline_label: 31 October 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Mid-career investigators, clinicians and allied healthcare professionals who hold a PhD, an MD in respiratory medicine or an equivalent qualification, and who want to visit an institution outside their home country for up to one month; the host institution must not be in the applicant's country.

records.title: FWO Junior Postdoctoral Fellowship
records.awarding_body: Research Foundation Flanders (FWO)
records.deadline_label: 16 November 2026 at 5pm
records.eligibility_summary: Researchers with a PhD thesis, or an equivalent recognised degree, obtained no more than three years before 1 October of the fellowship start year, who need a supervisor at a Flemish host institution and have not held this fellowship before.

records.title: International Student Leadership Award (ISLA) - Fall
records.awarding_body: Toronto Metropolitan University
records.deadline_label: February 16, 2027 (extended deadline). The fall 2027 awards application opens on AwardSpring on November 2, 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate international students who are starting their first year at a Canadian post-secondary institution on a full-time basis, are required to pay international tuition fees, and hold a final admission average of at least 86%, an A, or an equivalent. Any gap year taken must be no longer than one academic year.

records.title: Beca al Talento Académico Internacional
records.awarding_body: Tecnológico de Monterrey
records.deadline_label: January 22, 2027 (Cierre de convocatoria). Applications open from August 24, 2026; admission deadline January 20, 2027; results February 18, 2027
records.eligibility_summary: Candidates in their final year of, or who have completed, bachillerato or high school study in a named Latin American or Caribbean country, who are under 21 at the time of application, hold an average of at least 90/100, have been admitted to a professional programme at the Tecnológico de Monterrey starting in August 2027, and score at least 1,360 on the PAA or the equivalent converted SAT or ACT.

records.title: HHMI Janelia Joint Graduate Program in Neuroscience (with Johns Hopkins University)
records.awarding_body: HHMI Janelia Research Campus, in collaboration with Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine
records.deadline_label: December 3 (annual; the official page states no year)
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold a B.S. or B.A., apply directly to the Johns Hopkins neuroscience programme, and indicate an interest in conducting thesis research at Janelia by naming one to four Janelia group leaders. TOEFL or IELTS scores are required for students from non-English-speaking countries.

records.title: Organization of American States (OAS) Scholarship at Colorado State University
records.awarding_body: Colorado State University International Enrollment Center, in partnership with the Organization of American States
records.deadline_label: No closing date published - the OAS announcement lists 'Rolling admission' for CSU bachelor's programmes and states that graduate admission deadlines vary; applications are being taken for newly admitted Fall 2027 students
records.eligibility_summary: Citizens or permanent residents of any OAS member state except the United States, admitted to a degree-seeking on-campus programme at Colorado State University's Fort Collins campus. Only transfer undergraduate and graduate students are considered (new first-year students and SPUR campus students are not eligible), and students holding a full departmental assistantship are excluded.

records.title: Programa de Cooperacion Internacional del Gobierno de Chile para Policias Extranjeras Uniformadas (CECIPU)
records.awarding_body: Programa CECIPU - Secretaria Ejecutiva, Ministerio de Seguridad Publica de Chile
records.eligibility_summary: Serving officers, non-commissioned officers and enlisted personnel of the uniformed police forces of countries participating in CECIPU who apply to join the programme. Civil police institutions are not accepted. Applicants who do not speak Spanish must have a medium to medium-high command of Spanish, sufficient to understand and express themselves adequately in speech and writing. A valid official passport is mandatory, and life insurance is compulsory.

records.title: Programa de Becas de Investigacion para Estudiantes 2026-2027 (FCM UNCUYO)
records.awarding_body: Facultad de Ciencias Medicas, Universidad Nacional de Cuyo - Direccion de Investigacion y Relaciones Institucionales
records.deadline_label: 20 November 2026 (student registration closes)
records.eligibility_summary: Regular students of Medicine, Licenciatura en enfermeria or Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud at the Facultad de Ciencias Medicas of the Universidad Nacional de Cuyo who have already passed at least the first full year of their degree. Students apply individually or as a pair to projects put forward by faculty researchers. The faculty's own teaching and research staff qualify as project supervisors.

records.title: DGIST Government Scholarship for International Graduate Students
records.awarding_body: DGIST (Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology)
records.deadline_label: DGIST 2027 Spring 3rd round online application period: 5 November 2026 to 19 November 2026 (Korean Standard Time)
records.eligibility_summary: Open to international applicants who are admitted to a DGIST graduate programme in one of DGIST's listed departments. DGIST states that admission to the graduate school guarantees automatic registration to the scholarship without any additional process.

records.title: Fu Jen Catholic University Scholarship for New International Students (Doctoral Degree Programs)
records.awarding_body: Fu Jen Catholic University
records.deadline_label: Spring 2027 international student applications: online application and document submission from 14 September 2026 13:00 to 14 October 2026 23:59. Fall 2027 first round: 15 October 2026 13:00 to 4 December 2026 23:59.
records.eligibility_summary: Open to new international students applying for admission to a degree programme at Fu Jen Catholic University who tick the scholarship when submitting the online admission application. The award is decided as part of admission, so admission is a precondition.

records.title: Chula LINK Scholarship 2026
records.awarding_body: Chulalongkorn University (Office of International Affairs and Global Network)
records.deadline_label: 31 October 2026
records.eligibility_summary: International students who do not hold a Thai passport, admitted to or currently studying in the first semester at Chulalongkorn University, enrolled in a Master's or doctoral degree programme.

records.title: SEARCA Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program
records.awarding_body: Southeast Asian Regional Center for Graduate Study and Research in Agriculture (SEARCA)
records.deadline_label: 31 October 2026

records.title: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (JSP)
records.awarding_body: Asian Development Bank (financed by the Government of Japan)
records.deadline_label: No single ADB deadline; applications go to a designated institution at least six months before the intended start of studies

records.title: AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
records.awarding_body: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India
records.deadline_label: 31 October 2026 for student applications for academic year 2026-27
records.eligibility_summary: Girl students only, up to two per family, with family income below Rs 8 lakh per annum, admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved undergraduate degree programme or to the second year through lateral entry. Renewal requires admission to the subsequent year of the same course.

records.title: Undergraduate International Study Grants (Massey University)
records.awarding_body: Massey University
records.funding_type: Tuition Fee Waiver (NZ$15,000 towards tuition fees)
records.deadline_label: No application deadline - the grant is assessed at the point of admission for any 2027 intake
records.eligibility_summary: New international students enrolling full-time at Massey University for the first time in 2027, in one of fifteen listed undergraduate degrees, studying onshore in New Zealand. Students holding a fully funded government scholarship (Fed Aid, SACM, Manaaki, TSLS or similar) are not eligible.

records.title: Postgraduate International Study Grants (Massey University)
records.awarding_body: Massey University
records.funding_type: Tuition Fee Waiver (NZ$10,000 towards tuition fees)
records.deadline_label: No application deadline - the grant is assessed at the point of admission for any 2027 intake
records.eligibility_summary: New international students enrolling full-time at Massey University for the first time in 2027, in one of twenty-two listed Master's degrees, studying onshore in New Zealand. Students holding a fully funded government scholarship (Fed Aid, SACM, Manaaki, TSLS or similar) are not eligible.

records.title: Roberta Sykes Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Aurora Education Foundation
records.degree_levels: Doctoral Research, Postgraduate Coursework, Postgraduate Research
records.deadline_label: 29 January 2027
records.eligibility_summary: Open to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students only, at doctoral research, postgraduate coursework or postgraduate research level, full time, in any area of study, at a recognised overseas university. Scholars must embody academic excellence and show a commitment to improving outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.

records.title: First Nations Cancer Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Aurora Education Foundation
records.degree_levels: Postgraduate Certificate, Master's, PhD, Honours, Graduate Certificate, Research Postdoctoral
records.deadline_label: 11 September 2026 (2026 round, now closed)
records.eligibility_summary: Open to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students only, undertaking full-time postgraduate study or research in a cancer-related field in health, research or policy, at a full-time study load. Applicants must demonstrate how their study or research will affect Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities in improving cancer-related outcomes.

records.title: ACU Stipend Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Australian Catholic University
records.deadline_label: 1 April 2027 (next round)
records.eligibility_summary: Open to all applicants, domestic or overseas, who are enrolled in an accredited research higher degree at ACU and whose proposed research aligns with any of ACU's broad areas of expertise. Covers a Research Doctorate or Research Masters degree.

records.title: Western Sydney University Research Scholarship - Spring Release, Quarter 1 2027 commencement
records.awarding_body: Western Sydney University
records.deadline_label: 11.59pm AEDT Sunday 18 October 2026
records.eligibility_summary: For domestic applicants and for international applicants who have completed or are completing an MPhil or MRes at Western Sydney University, applying to commence a doctoral program in Quarter 1 2027 or who commenced one in 2026. All recipients must study full time and be onshore in Australia at the scholarship commencement date.

records.title: COMSTECH Fellowships for Research and Trainings in Human Nutrition, Nutraceuticals and Food Sciences
records.awarding_body: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
records.deadline_label: No closing date published; COMSTECH states 'COMSTECH will accept applications on a yearly basis' and that only 10 fellowships are awarded on a first-come, first-served basis
records.eligibility_summary: Open to citizens of all OIC member states. Applicants need at least a Bachelor's degree, with a Master's or PhD an asset, and an academic background in food security, agriculture, food science, food safety or a related field. Experience requirements differ by degree level, and applicants must be fluent in English and available full-time for the whole fellowship.

records.title: COMSTECH Fellowships for Research and Advanced Training in Virology and Vaccine Technologies
records.awarding_body: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
records.deadline_label: No closing date published; the official page states 'The call is currently open'
records.eligibility_summary: Open to citizens of OIC member states who are young scientists employed by a research institution in an OIC country, holding at least an M.S. in Biomedical or Health Sciences for graduate-level application or a Ph.D. in Biomedical or Health Sciences for post-graduate-level application. Age limits are 35 for graduate studies and 45 for post-graduate studies, with preference given to women scientists, those early in their research career, and those working in OIC least-developed countries or Muslim-majority areas in non-OIC states.

records.title: COMSTECH Research Fellowships for Women Scientists in Least Developed Countries (LDCs) in the OIC
records.awarding_body: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
records.deadline_label: No fixed deadline; the awarding body states 'Applications / Nominations are open all around the year'
records.eligibility_summary: Open to young women scientists and engineers who are citizens of an OIC least-developed country, or who are employed by a research institution in an OIC country, and who hold at least an M.S. or equivalent for graduate studies or a Ph.D. for post-graduate studies, or who are engaged in active research. Age limits are 35 for graduate studies and 45 for post-graduate studies, with preference for women scientists at the beginning of their research career in OIC least-developed countries.

records.title: EAC Scholarship Programme (EACSP) - Two-Year Funded Master's Scholarships, Cohort 4 (Phase II)
records.awarding_body: Inter-University Council for East Africa (IUCEA), implementing the East African Community and Federal Republic of Germany initiative
records.deadline_label: 10 September 2026, 17:00 East Africa Time (Cohort 4; now closed)
records.eligibility_summary: Citizens of any of the eight EAC Partner States, aged below 35 at the time of application, holding a Bachelor's degree at Second Class Upper Division, Distinction or equivalent, and applying to an eligible Master's programme at a participating university in an EAC Partner State other than their country of citizenship. Applicants must complete the separate online scholarship application in addition to a university admission application.

records.title: COMSTECH Research Fellowships for Least Developed Countries (LDCs) in the OIC
records.awarding_body: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
records.deadline_label: No fixed deadline; the awarding body states 'Applications / Nominations are open all around the year'
records.eligibility_summary: Open to young scientists and engineers who are citizens of an OIC least-developed country, or who are employed by a research institution in an OIC country, and who hold at least an M.S. or equivalent for graduate studies or a Ph.D. for post-graduate studies, or who are involved in active research. Age limits are 35 for graduate studies and 45 for post-graduate studies, with preference given to young scientists, particularly women scientists, at the beginning of their research career and those working in OIC least-developed countries.

records.title: Kingdom of Morocco – Government of Rwanda Scholarships (2026/2027)
records.awarding_body: Kingdom of Morocco, scholarship call published by the Higher Education Council (HEC) of Rwanda
records.eligibility_summary: Rwandan nationals applying through the Higher Education Council of Rwanda. Diploma and bachelor's candidates must have completed STEM-related combinations of technical secondary school or secondary studies in 2024/2025 and scored at least 70% in the 2025 national examinations. Master's and PhD candidates must hold at least 14/20 (2nd class upper division) or equivalent from the previous completed level.

records.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Cape Town (2027 intake, postgraduate)
records.awarding_body: University of Cape Town
records.deadline_label: 31 October 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Citizens of any African country who face significant social and economic barriers to higher education and are applying for a first bachelor's degree, a UCT postgraduate diploma in the Faculty of Health Sciences, an honours degree, or a coursework master's degree. UCT explicitly encourages applications from young women, people living with disabilities, refugees and forcibly displaced youth.

records.title: AUF Virtual Mobility Grant for International Distance Degree Programmes (FOAD/IFIC call 2026/27)
records.awarding_body: Agence universitaire de la Francophonie (AUF) / Institut de la Formation a Distance de la Francophonie (IFIC)
records.deadline_label: Closed 14 September 2026 at 23:59 Europe/Paris for programmes starting January/February 2027; 9 June 2026 for programmes starting September/October 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Francophone students who are high-achieving or have limited resources, enrolling in one of more than 150 international distance degree programmes run by AUF member institutions in 13 countries.

records.title: Mauritius-Africa Scholarship Scheme (MASS)
records.awarding_body: Ministry of Tertiary Education, Science and Research, Republic of Mauritius
records.deadline_label: No central date is published: each nominating agency sets its own deadline and communicates it to prospective applicants. For the 2026 edition the Mauritian public universities opened their own application windows from October 2025 and closed them between February and March 2026, so the next edition is expected to follow the same annual cycle.
records.eligibility_summary: Resident citizens of African Union member states or African Commonwealth countries aged between 18 and 26 for undergraduate programmes or under 40 for MPhil and PhD programmes by 1 January of the intake year, with a qualifying secondary or undergraduate result of about 60% or 12/20 or the equivalent, and holding or applying for a place at a listed Mauritian public higher education institution.

records.title: International Excellence Scholarship 2027 (The University of Newcastle, Australia)
records.awarding_body: The University of Newcastle, Australia
records.funding_type: Tuition Fee Waiver (20% of gross annual international tuition fee)
records.deadline_label: No application deadline - scholarships are automatically assessed on application for admission for 2027 or later commencement
records.eligibility_summary: International full fee-paying students commencing an eligible CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at the University of Newcastle, not in a quota-limited program, not holding another University scholarship, and residing within 50 km of the campus on their Confirmation of Enrolment. Must be able to meet the financial obligations of a full fee-paying international student as specified by the Australian Government.

records.title: Barbara Wood Memorial Foundation Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Barbara Wood Memorial Foundation, administered by the New Zealand Federation of Women's Institutes
records.deadline_label: 1 February 2027
records.eligibility_summary: Open to tertiary students of any gender who were born in the South Pacific region, which the Federation defines as the Pacific island nations as well as New Zealand and Australia, and who wish to study in New Zealand or anywhere in the South Pacific.

records.title: Errol Walton Barrow Scholarships
records.awarding_body: Ministry of Education Transformation, Government of Barbados
records.funding_type: Tuition Fee Waiver, Living Allowance and Airfare (bonded)
records.deadline_label: 6 August 2026 (2026 cycle - closed)
records.eligibility_summary: Citizens of Barbados who have been accepted at an accredited institution and attended one of the listed newer secondary schools.

records.title: Perimeter Scholars International (PSI) Master's Program - Full Scholarship
records.awarding_body: Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics
records.deadline_label: January 24, 2027, 11:59 pm ET
records.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants from outside Canada who hold, or are completing, a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in physics, mathematics, astronomy or a related field, with a strong academic record. Students with other degrees may be considered in exceptional cases if they can demonstrate understanding of classical mechanics, electromagnetism, special relativity, quantum mechanics and statistical physics.

records.title: Killam Fellowships Program (Fulbright Canada)
records.awarding_body: Fulbright Canada, Foundation for Educational Exchange between Canada and the United States of America
records.deadline_label: 31 January 2027
records.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate students registered at one of the participating American or Canadian universities who are planning to spend a semester or a full academic year at a participating university in the other country. Direct exchange applicants must be registered at a participating university and plan to visit a participating university in the other country.

records.title: CSHL School of Biological Sciences Ph.D. Program (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)
records.awarding_body: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory, School of Biological Sciences
records.deadline_label: 1 December 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent by the time they enrol. The School welcomes applicants from any area of biology as well as non-bioscience backgrounds such as computer science, engineering, mathematics, chemistry and physics. Students from non-English language universities must submit TOEFL or IELTS scores. The GRE general test and subject tests are not required and there is no minimum GPA.

records.title: Posse Foundation Scholarship
records.awarding_body: The Posse Foundation
records.eligibility_summary: High school seniors nominated by their high school or a community-based organisation in a Posse recruitment city, in the first term of their senior year, who demonstrate leadership within their high school, community or family and demonstrate academic potential, and who apply on time.

records.title: John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship (Curtin University)
records.awarding_body: Curtin University
records.funding_type: Tuition Fee Waiver (40% of tuition fee for the scholarship term)
records.deadline_label: 1 October 2027 (applications opened 27 July 2026)
records.eligibility_summary: International, fee-paying, non-sponsored students of any nationality except Australian, enrolled in a Curtin undergraduate degree or Master's degree by coursework, studying at a Curtin Western Australian campus commencing in 2027 or 2028, with a Course-Weighted Average of 95% or equivalent in their most recent eligible course of study, and not enrolled in an excluded course or programme type.

records.title: New Horizons for Women: Hine Kahukura Education Awards
records.awarding_body: New Horizons for Women: Hine Kahukura
records.deadline_label: 11.59 pm, Tuesday 25 August 2026 (round now closed)
records.eligibility_summary: Women enrolled in an NZQA or Universities New Zealand approved tertiary qualification for study in 2027 in any field, at certificate, diploma or degree level, who are New Zealand citizens or ordinarily resident in New Zealand and either have lived here on a resident-class visa for at least three years or are a refugee or protected person of New Zealand, and who have not previously received a Trust award at that level.

records.title: Sonja Davies Peace Award Fund
records.awarding_body: New Horizons for Women: Hine Kahukura
records.deadline_label: 30 October 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Open to a woman, or a group whose project leader is a woman, who is developing an initiative to advance peace in New Zealand. The three stated eligible categories are an informal group with peace promotion among its aims, an individual enrolled at a tertiary institution, and a formal group. Applicants must be a New Zealand citizen or hold a resident class visa and currently live in New Zealand, and must not have previously received a New Horizons for Women: Hine Kahukura award.

records.title: Toloa Tertiary Scholarship (Toloa Scholarships - tertiary stream, Ministry for Pacific Peoples)
records.awarding_body: Ministry for Pacific Peoples, New Zealand Government
records.degree_levels: Tertiary (second year and beyond of a full-time STEM degree)
records.deadline_label: 5 pm, Monday 9 February 2026 (tertiary applications closed)
records.eligibility_summary: Pacific students who have completed at least one year of study and are continuing full-time STEM study in New Zealand, entering their second year or beyond.

records.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at The American University in Cairo
records.awarding_body: The American University in Cairo (AUC), in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation
records.deadline_label: 2 November 2026
records.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be residing in an African country and hold citizenship of at least one African country, be aged 35 or younger at the time of application, be new graduate degree-seeking students meeting AUC graduate admissions requirements (transfers are not eligible), hold a bachelor's degree with a minimum overall GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent, and demonstrate financial need.
